description: Search Lebanese legislation (laws, decrees, decisions), their articles, court rulings, or Official Gazette issues, by keyword: Arabic words, French words (articles the Centre published in French, and the codes' French or English names), or a law's numeric id. Returns verbatim snippets from the Lebanese University's database, never an AI-written summary. Not legal advice.

kind.description: narrow to one category; omit to search all four

query.description: words to search for, Arabic or French, or a law's id

year.description: only laws issued this year (applies when kind is "laws" or omitted)

name: search_legislation
